issues.observation: The crank appears offset from the plain drive cylinder, with no visible coupling between them.
The drive sits outside the housing, while the cutter is inside; no shaft, opening, or other visible connection reaches the cutter.
The guide appears to attach to a solid housing wall. No visible passage carries a pencil from the guide to the cutter.
The cutter is represented mainly by a cylinder with one spiral strip, rather than clearly legible helical cutting geometry.
The drawer is a removable open box, but the housing has no visible drawer opening or pull feature; its intended access is unclear.

summary: The six proposed pieces are distinguishable and can be viewed apart, but the assembled geometry does not show the essential pencil path or a continuous crank-to-cutter drive. Passing numeric checks do not resolve those missing interfaces.
